comment:
* CleanerImpl manages a set of object references and corresponding cleaning actions.
 * CleanerImpl provides the functionality of {@link java.lang.ref.Cleaner}.

variables.name: cleanerImplAccess
variables.comment: * An object to access the CleanerImpl from a Cleaner; set by Cleaner init.

variables.name: phantomCleanableList
variables.comment: * Heads of a CleanableList for each reference type.

variables.name: queue
variables.comment: The ReferenceQueue of pending cleaning actions

methods.name: public static void setCleanerImplAccess(Function<Cleaner, CleanerImpl> access)
methods.comment:
* Called by Cleaner static initialization to provide the function
     * to map from Cleaner to CleanerImpl.
     * @param access a function to map from Cleaner to CleanerImpl

methods.name: static CleanerImpl getCleanerImpl(Cleaner cleaner)
methods.comment:
* Called to get the CleanerImpl for a Cleaner.
     * @param cleaner the cleaner
     * @return the corresponding CleanerImpl

methods.name: public void start(Cleaner cleaner, ThreadFactory threadFactory)
methods.comment:
* Starts the Cleaner implementation.
     * Ensure this is the CleanerImpl for the Cleaner.
     * When started waits for Cleanables to be queued.
     * @param cleaner the cleaner
     * @param threadFactory the thread factory

methods.name: public void start(Cleaner cleaner)
methods.comment:
* Starts the Cleaner implementation. Does not need a thread factory as it
     * should be used in the system cleaner only.
     * @param cleaner the cleaner
     * @hide

methods.name: public void run()
methods.comment:
* Process queued Cleanables as long as the cleanable lists are not empty. * A Cleanable is in one of the lists for each Object and for the Cleaner * itself. * Terminates when the Cleaner is no longer reachable and * has been cleaned and there are no more Cleanable instances * for which the object is reachable. *

* If the thread is a ManagedLocalsThread, the threadlocals * are erased before each cleanup

methodNames: public static void setCleanerImplAccess(Function<Cleaner, CleanerImpl> access)
public void start(Cleaner cleaner, ThreadFactory threadFactory)
